items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 2:28 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

motions.item_title: Execution of Agreement pertaining to the Fire Department’s use of Radio Communications System, CSD-2023-522
motions.text: "That the Fire Chief be authorized to execute the agreement with The Regional Municipality of Waterloo Police Services Board, The Regional Municipality of Waterloo and various municipalities in the Region of Waterloo pertaining to the System Infrastructure and access to a related radio communications system; said agreement to be to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor, as outlined in Community Services Department report CSD-2023-522."
motions.text_html: "That the Fire Chief be authorized to execute the agreement with The Regional Municipality of Waterloo Police Services Board, The Regional Municipality of Waterloo and various municipalities in the Region of Waterloo pertaining to the System Infrastructure and access to a related radio communications system; said agreement to be to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor, as outlined in Community Services Department report CSD-2023-522."

motions.text: "That a joint in-camera meeting of City Council be held with the Councils of the Regional Municipality of Waterloo and all Area Municipalities within the Region on Friday December 15, 2023 at 1:00 p.m. to be held at the Region of Waterloo, Council Chambers, 150 Frederick Street, Kitchener, with a further option for members to participate electronically, to receive education and training related to Indigenous History and Reconciliation as authorized by Sections 239 (3.1) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."
